name: BTClock
author: kravens
description: Bitcoin block height, price, Moscow time, fees, halving, market cap, supply and Bitaxe stats on a row of BTClock-style panels

barWidget.description: Rotates your choice of Bitcoin screens across little e-paper panels, reacts to new blocks, and opens a settings panel on left click

schema.label: Retry interval while no instance can be reached
Fiat currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD)
Mempool API instance to try first (mempool.space, mempool.emzy.de, custom)
Screens in rotation order, space-separated (height price moscow fees nextfee halving mcap supply bitaxeHash bitaxeBest)
Jump to the block height when a new block arrives
Flash the panels when a new block arrives
Send a notification when a new block arrives
Bitaxe address on the local network (host name or IP, optional :port)
Your own mempool instance, as http(s)://host[:port]
